text:
Renee Coleman: Heads-up  Paladin Health enablement Thurs 11am PT. Customer asked for a short exec demo first 10m for the renewal stakeholders, then the hands-on lab. Maya is OOO so need a coverage plan.
Diego Mendez: I can do the exec demo + quick metrics (10m). Can shorten the lab to 45m.
Ivy Chen: I'll own the hands-on lab but need someone to run the migration checklist segment and capture blockers for renewals.
Omar Hassan: I can take the migration checklist and moderate Q&A. Also will tag the renewal team when blockers surface.
Renee Coleman: Proposed split:
```
11:00-11:10am PT  Exec demo & success signals (Diego)
11:10-11:25am PT  Migration checklist + blockers (Omar)
11:25-12:10pm PT  Hands-on lab + support rotation (Ivy)
12:10-12:15pm PT  Wrap & feedback capture (All)
```
Diego Mendez: I'll add a 1-slide pre-read and call out the KPIs they wanted.
Ivy Chen: I'll post the lab link and condensed runbook 24h ahead.
Omar Hassan: I'll prepare the blocker triage template and ensure owners are assigned in the notes.
OnboardingBot: Paladin Health enablement updated by Diego Mendez. 32 RSVPs. Recording enabled.
Renee Coleman: Reminder: renewal touchpoint in 2.5 weeks. Post-session actions need to include: migration completion status, outstanding blockers with owners, and CSAT notes.
Diego Mendez: I'll mark the pre-read and slide in the invite.
Ivy Chen: lab VM snapshot URL posted: https://internal.docs/paladin-lab (internal).
Omar Hassan: I'll synthesize notes into the renewal tracker after the session.
Renee Coleman: Great. If anything changes react with :x: here. Otherwise I'll update the calendar invite and set reminders. Thanks team.
Diego Mendez: Done  invite updated to include exec segment.
Ivy Chen: All items posted.
OnboardingBot: Reminder set: Paladin Health enablement 24h and 1h prior.
Renee Coleman: Final  see you Thursday 11:00am PT.
